stories.title: Zelensky sfida Putin: "Parliamoci a dicembre al G20 di Miami". Cremlino: "Viaggio nemmeno discusso"

en.title: Zelensky challenges Putin: "Let's talk in December at the G20 in Miami". Kremlin: "Trip not even discussed"

en.title: Train derails in France, police prioritize sabotage theory
en.summary: A train carrying 180 passengers derailed in northern France, resulting in 44 injured passengers, including one woman in serious condition.

en.title: Train derailed in France, police investigate sabotage
en.summary: Investigators believe a train derailment near Cléon in northern France may have been a deliberate act, injuring 44 people with one woman in critical condition.

en.title: Zelensky proposes meeting Putin at G20 in Miami in December
en.summary: Ukraine's leader indicated in an interview that he would attend the December G20 summit in Miami if Putin also participates in the event.

stories.title: Alessandro Di Battista è arrivato all'ospedale Gemelli di Roma. Il rientro nella notte a Ciampino

en.title: Alessandro Di Battista arrived at Gemelli hospital in Rome. Return overnight to Ciampino
en.summary: Di Battista was hospitalized following a lengthy journey from Cuba and a surgical procedure, then transferred via medical aircraft with special precautions to manage pressure changes during flight.

stories.title: Normandia, 44 feriti nel treno deragliato. La polizia: “Probabile sabotaggio”

en.title: Normandy, 44 injured in derailed train. Police: "Probable sabotage"
en.summary: A train derailment occurred Friday evening in Normandy, leaving 44 people injured including one young person in serious condition, with authorities suggesting possible sabotage.

stories.title: Di Battista atterrato a Ciampino dopo un volo a bassa quota di 12 ore da Cuba. Ricoverato al Gemelli

en.title: Di Battista landed at Ciampino after 12-hour low-altitude flight from Cuba. Hospitalized at Gemelli
en.summary: The former Five Star deputy fell ill in Cuba on August 28, underwent emergency surgery, and returned to Italy by medical aircraft, now admitted to Gemelli hospital.

stories.title: Di Battista arrivato a Roma e ricoverato al Gemelli. Il rientro da Cuba dopo l’intervento d’urgenza

en.title: Di Battista arrived in Rome and admitted to Gemelli. Return from Cuba after emergency surgery
en.summary: The former parliamentarian departed Havana yesterday aboard a medical aircraft for a 12-hour journey organized in stages at low altitude to Rome, where he was hospitalized.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia, le news. Zelensky propone di incontrare Putin al G20 di Miami a dicembre. Ma il Cremlino frena

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war, news. Zelensky proposes meeting Putin at G20 in Miami in December. But Kremlin hesitates
en.summary: Zelensky suggested a presidential meeting at the December Miami G20 summit, though Moscow indicated Putin's attendance remains undecided. Cross-border attacks overnight killed two in Moscow raids, while Ukrainian drones struck Russian chemical facilities and cities including Odessa.

en.title: Emma Bonino from Piedmont to the world: the radical novel of the girl from Bra
en.summary: Emma Bonino, originally from Bra in Piedmont, followed a long path in public life while maintaining strong ties to her roots.

en.title: Production advancing slowly in Lombardy
